{{Quote|There's a safe dock in the Imperial Enclave on ''Gall''...|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 1">[[Shadows of the Empire 1|''Shadows of the Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave''' was the central [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] stronghold of the [[Cadavine Sector Fleet]] in the remote [[Cadavine sector/Legends|Cadavine sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gall/Legends|Gall]], [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Zhar/Legends|Zhar]] in the [[Zhar system]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] took sanctuary at the [[Imperial Enclave|Enclave]] while still in possession of the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen body of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to seek repairs on his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] organized a small party to try and rescue Solo from Fett, but the Imperial forces present at the Enclave repelled the Rebels during the [[Battle of Gall]].
